ItemChanges.description:
A partial update. Only fields present in the request are changed.

Holding fields are re-validated as a whole after merging, so a PATCH can't
produce an invalid combination (e.g. switching to raw but keeping a grade).

post.description: Returns a presigned POST. Upload the file directly to storage, then call `.../images/{image_id}/complete`. The policy pins the key, content type, and size.
Verifies the stored file (size, type, signature, SHA-256) and makes it the card's front or back photo, replacing the previous one.
